summary: Full backend + frontend test of the new /medical-6-combo landing page and its endpoints. All 5 backend pytest cases pass (combo product at ₹297 with 6 files, combo-6 add-ons returns only ct-mri-xray-guide & radiology-guide @₹149, regular /api/add-ons correctly excludes combo6-only, /api/products contains the combo (7+ items), checkout returns 503 'Payments are not configured'). Frontend desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) both render all 10 target testid sections with zero horizontal overflow. Live total correctly updates: 297 -> 446 (CT) -> 595 (both) -> 297 (untick); hero/sticky/pricing buy buttons all mirror the live total. Buyer-email dialog opens on buy click; after submitting a valid email the backend returns 503 (seen in console). Reviews section correctly hidden (no reviews). Regression /products shows combo card linking to /medical-6-combo; product detail page's 'View Full Details' links to /medical-6-combo; /medical-reference-bundle still loads.

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly returns 503 'Payments are not configured' (expected while Razorpay keys unset). Toast text was not captured in body during script wait (likely auto-dismissed quickly), but 503 was observed in browser console. Suggest verifying toast remains visible long enough for users to read, or render an inline error inside the dialog.

action_items: Optional: ensure the 'Payments are not configured' error is surfaced as a persistent toast or inline dialog message (currently appears to auto-dismiss quickly).
Covers for Medicine Reference, CT Scan and Radiology are placeholders pending user upload — expected, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: MedicalCombo6.jsx is large (~390 lines) with inline constant arrays (guides, audience, faq, difference). Consider extracting data constants to a sibling file for maintainability.
Sample tab testids use pattern 'combo6-tab-{key}' while the task description referenced 'combo6-sample-tab-*' — align naming or document the actual pattern in task notes.
Reviews section is correctly conditionally rendered; good.
seed_data_creation: None — relies on existing seeded products
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for the medical-6 combo are stable. Sample tab testids are 'combo6-tab-{key}' (disease/medicine/lab/emergency/ecg/ayurvedic). Reviews section testid 'combo6-reviews' exists but is conditionally rendered only when reviews list is non-empty — currently hidden by design. Payments are intentionally unset; checkout correctly surfaces 503.
